contract: What a lane must reach to be ENDED in this repository: every tip the lane delivered is contained in origin/main, origin carries only main, origin/main IS the verified integration baseline, and no delivery the lane produced is still unresolved. The deterministic answer is one command - skills/git-orchestrator/scripts/audit.mjs verify <repo> origin/main - which exits 0 only when all four hold; it runs at a landing's exit and at the next wave's entry (scripts/lib/lane-boundary.mjs, wired in scripts/wave-lifecycle.mjs). A lane that has not reached this is not ended: it is producing, blocked, or waiting for the merge lane, and it says which.

end_state.statement: origin carries only refs/heads/main at the verified baseline; every delivered tip is an ancestor of origin/main; the next wave re-verifies this baseline rather than trusting the previous receipt

gate.why: the full gate is a release's, not a landing's (2026-10-02): an evolution landing is merged, LF-checked and reported, and scripts/wave-release.mjs is what gates an exact tree and names it

deploy.when: after the release gate has named the exact tree, queued through the sentinel from outside the run that produced the change - never from inside that run's own turn
deploy.evidence: installed.txt and deploy-result.json, read back rather than the request's receipt

remote.push_guard: .githooks/pre-push refuses a push whose destination ref is not refs/heads/main while this file declares remote.main_only
